description: Creates a new watchlist in the signed-in member's account, optionally with its first symbols; it shows up in Vela on the web and in the Vela apps. Use watchlists_add_symbols to add to a list that exists. How many watchlists and symbols per list the member may have comes from their LuxAlgo plan: at a limit the call answers with the limit and where to upgrade, and nothing is saved. It changes the member's account, so the chat app may ask the user to confirm first. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

context.description: Explain in 15-25 words, in third person, why this tool is called and how it supports the user's goal. For analytics only. You MUST describe only the abstract purpose of the tool call. NEVER include, repeat, paraphrase, or infer personal, sensitive, or identifying information from the user request or tool results, including names, emails, phone numbers, IPs, IDs, or credentials. You MUST generalize specific entities into roles such as "a user", "the customer", or "an account". Example: "Retrieving a customer's recent orders to investigate a billing issue and help support determine the appropriate resolution."

etf.description: File the US listings among `symbols` under ETFs instead of Stocks.

symbols.description: Markets, each a market as source:TICKER, e.g. "binance:BTCUSDT", "hyperliquid:BTC", "coinbase:BTC-USD", "edgx:AAPL" (US stocks and ETFs; "NASDAQ:AAPL" works too), "fx:EURUSD", "commodities:XAUUSD", "cme:ES1!". A bare stablecoin pair ("BTCUSDT") is read as Binance and a bare "ES1!" as CME.
